scenario: 内部钓鱼邮件演练触发恶意 URL 告警（误报）

judgment.summary: EDR alert triggered by phishing signature match on URL http://phish-test.internal/, but Threat Intelligence confirms this is a legitimate internal security awareness simulation campaign, not a real threat.
evidence_chain: query_alert_detail shows source IP 10.0.3.45 clicked URL http://phish-test.internal/ which matched rule 'Phishing Link Clicked - Malicious URL Detected'.
query_threat_intel reports ioc_value 'http://phish-test.internal/' has is_malicious set to false with source 'Internal Security Awareness Platform'.
query_threat_intel raw_intel explicitly states 'URL is part of internal phishing simulation campaign run by Security Awareness team.'
query_asset_info confirms asset 10.0.3.45 (hr-workstation-12) is a normal workstation, not a scanner, bastion, or honeypot.

remediation: Mark alert A06 as false positive in the SOC platform to close the investigation ticket immediately.
Send a notification to user jane.doe@company.com confirming the click was part of a scheduled security awareness drill to reinforce training.
Review detection rules to whitelist known internal simulation domains if they continue to generate high-severity alerts unnecessarily.
